full_judgment:
Mr. A.K.M. Shahidul Huq, J: No one appears to press the revisional application filed under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure on behalf of the petitioner and the same is taken up for disposal on merit. 

	2. This Rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the impugned judgment and decree dated 23.08.2000 and 02.09.2000 respectively passed by the Additional District Judge, 3rd Court, Comilla, allowing the appeal in part and dismissing the Suit No.111 of 1995 in part of the court of the court of Senior Assistant Judge, Burichong, Comilla which decreed the suit declaring title of the plaintiffs in 109 decimals out of 118 decimals of land of the suit tank by his judgment and decree dated 09.07.1997 and 15.07.1997 respectively passed in Title Suit No.111 of 1995 should not be set aside and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

	3. The short facts for disposal of the instant Rule is that the case of the plaintiffs Chandra Nath Sen and Ombika Charan Chowdhury were the owners of the schedule property in equal 8 annas share each in superior right (Dar Taluki right) and accordingly C.S. Khatian was prepared in their names. Chandra Nath Sen died leaving two sons namely Kamini Mohan Sen and Ashwini Mohan Sen and Ombika Charan Chowdhury died leaving only son Amullya Charan Chowdhury. Sekandar Ali predecessor of the plaintiffs took settlement of .59 decimals of land on 10th Magh, 1358 B.S. the share of Kamini Mohan Sen and Ashwini Mohan Sen who settled the said 59 decimals of land at Jama of 2 Taka 8 annas 9 pies granting Dakhila and while Sekandar Ali was in possession he died leaving the plaintiffs as his heirs. The owner of the other 8 annas share of the suit Plot Amulla Charan Chowdhury died leaving his only son Chitta Ranjan Chowdhury, the defendant No.1. The defendant No.1 managed to prepare the S.A. Khatian of the suit tank in his name alone. Thereafter a Shalish was held and it was decided in that Shalish that defendant No.1 would sell his 8 annas share measuring 59 decimals of the suit tank to the plaintiff Nos.1 and 2 at a consideration of Tk. 20,000/- (Twenty thousand) only and accordingly the defendant No.1 executed and registered a sale deed on 09.11.1992 in the name of the plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2 and delivered possession of his entire share of the suit tank measuring 59 decimals. Thus the plaintiffs became the owner and possessors of the entire suit tank measuring an area of 118decimals openly denying right title of others and adversely possession the suit tank for more than 12 years. The defendant No. l recently expressed that he has sold only 50 decimal out of 59 decimals of his share and the plaintiffs obtaining Certified copy of the said sale deed on 01.11.1995 came to know that the defendants collusively and fraudulently managed to write "50" decimals in stead of 59 decimals in the schedule of the aforesaid sale deed and hence the plaintiffs filed the suit for declaration of title in the entire suit tank. 

	4. The defendant contested in the suit by filing written statement denying the case of the plaintiffs contending inter alia that Chandra Nath Sen and Ombika Charan Chowdhury were the owners of the suit tank in equal share and C.R. Khatain was correctly prepared accordingly in their names. After amicable partition between them, Ombika Charan got the entire suit tank in is share. During life time of Chandra Nath Sen, his two sons Kamini Mohan and Ashwini Mohan left this country and permanently settled in India and they have never came to this country and after amicable partition Chandra Nath also left this country and settled in India. Ombika Charan died leaving his son Amullya Charan who also died leaving his only son defendant No. 1. Thus the defendant No.1 become the owner of entire suit tank and S.A. Khatian was prepared in the name of Amullya Charan and B.S. field survey was also prepared in the name of the defendant.

	He also denied settlement by granting Dakhila by Kamini Mohan and Ashwini Mohan Sen and prayed for dismissal of the suit. 

	5. The plaintiffs examined 6 P.Ws. and the defendant examined 3 D.Ws to prove their respective cases.

	6. Trial court considering the evidences on record found that the plaintiffs acquired title in 59 decimals of the suit tank by adverse possession the 8 annas share of Kamini Mohan Sen and Ashwini Mohan Sen and got 50 decimals by purchase (admitted Ext.3) from the defendant  and the trial Court decreed the suit declaring the right and title of the plaintiff in 109 decimals of land out of 118 decimals of suit tank giving clear finding that “বাদীগণের পূর্ববর্তী সেকান্দার আলী নালিশী পুকুরের অর্ধেক অংশে অর্থাৎ অশ্বিনী কুমার সেন ও কামিনী সেনের অংশীয়। II. আনা ভূমি দাখিলা মূলে ১৩৩৮ বাংলা সন হইতে নিরবচ্ছিন্ন ভাবে দখলে থাকার বিষয় প্রমাণিত হইয়াছে বলিয়া সিদ্ধান্ত গ্রহণ করা হইল।”

	7. The defendant being aggrieved by judgment and decree of the trial court preferred title appeal No. 265 of 1997 in the Court of the District Judge, 3rd Court, Comilla who allowed the appeal in part by the impugned judgment, setting aside the judgment and decree of the trial court in respect of 59 decimals of suit property of the share of Kamini Mohan and Ashwini Mohan Sen. 

	8. The learned Trial Court after discussing the oral evidences of the 6 PWs. found possession of the plaintiffs in the suit tank and the learned Appellate court also found that "দখল সম্পর্কে বিবাদী আপীল্যান্ট মৌখিক সাক্ষী তুলনা মূলক ভাবে কিঞ্চিৎদুর্বল ইহা অস্বীকার করিবার উপায় নাই।” Thus both the courts below concurrently found that the plaintiffs are in possession of the suit tank and the learned trial court rightly discarded the Ext Gha and Gha-1 S.A. Khatian and the Ext. Kha and Ga series the rent receipts giving sound reasoning that the defendant neither could prove the Claim of getting the entire suit tank amicably nor claim the remaining 59 decimals by any other means. 

	9. The Appellate Court illegally allowed the appeal in Part occasioning failure of justice and dismissed the suit in respect of 59 decimals which the plaintiff claim through Settlement from the landlord ignoring the legal evidences on record as such in view of the evidence of the 6 P.Ws. and admission of D.W. 2 Abdul Aziz Such as "নালিশা পুকুরে সেকান্দার আলী বন্দোবস্ত নিয়া and P.S.3 Abdul Hashem stated that “তিনি বলেন মহারাজার পরে চিত্তরঞ্জন নালিশা পুকুর দখল করে। তবে ১৯৯২ ইং সনে খরিদের পর বাদীগণ দখল করে।

	10. The learned Appellate Court without reversing the finding of the trial court regarding adverse possession of the plaintiff in the suit tank in respect of 8 annas share of Kamini Mohan and Ashwini Mohan Sen and failing to notice the averment relating to claim of adverse possession and title at paragraph 3 of the plaint illegally found in his impugned judgment that the plaintiffs did not claim adverse title and thus illegally and arbitrarily allowed the appeal in part and dismissed the suit in respect of aforesaid share measuring 59 decimals of the suit tank. 

	11. No one appears to press the Rule on behalf of the petitioner and no one appears on behalf of the opposite party to oppose the rule. 

	12. Perused the impugned judgment and decree of the last Court of fact and also perused the revisional application filed under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure considered the statements as made in the revisional application and the other materials on record on perusal of the impugned judgment I find at the trail the learned trial judge framed as many as 4 issues in determination of the suit the issues are: 
১। বর্তমান আকারে অত্র মামলা রক্ষনীয় কি?
২। অত্র মামলা তামাদিতে বারিত কি?
৩। বাদীগণ প্রার্থিতমতে প্রতিকার পাইতে পারে কি?
৪। বাদীগণ আর কি কি প্রতিকার পাইতে পারে?

	13. On perusal of the impugned judgment and decree of the last court of fact and on examination of both oral and documentary evidences on record and the attending facts and circumstances I find the appellate court has committed serious illegality in not considering the finding of the trial court regarding adverse possession of the plaintiff in the suit tank in respect of 8 annas share of Kamini Mohan and Ashwini Mohan Sen and failing to notice the averment relating to claim of adverse possession and title at paragraph 3 of the plaint illegally found in his impugned judgment that the plaintiffs did not claim adverse title and thus illegally and arbitrarily allowed the appeal in part and dismissed the suit in respect of aforesaid share measuring 59 decimals of the suit tank the said finding of the last court of fact is erroneous and not at all sustainable in the facts and circumstances of the instant case and on this point the very reversal of the last court of fact is not proper and not in accordance with law and the same is based on serious illegality material irregularity as well as the very finding of the learned appellate Judge is perverse finding which has resulted in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice. On that ground the very finding of the learned Appellate court is not tenable in law. I also find at the trial 6 P.Ws were examined and in view of the clear admission of D.Ws 2 and 3 who stated that Sekendar Ali “সেকান্দার আলী নালিশা ভূমি বন্দোবস্ত নিয়া.............. তবে ১৯৯২ ইং সনে খরিদের পর বাদীগণ (নালিশা পুকুর) দখল করে।”

	14. The appellate Court has committed serious illegality in not reversing the finding of the trial court regarding adverse possession and title of the plaintiff and failed to notice the averment as stated in paragraph 3 of the plaint and regarding claim and adverse possession and adverse title most arbitrary found in his impugned judgment that the plaintiff did not claim adverse possession and adverse title in the suit tank regarding 59 decimals of Sekendar and Ashwini Mohan Sen and thus most illegally and arbitrarily allowed the appeal in part. This finding of the learned Appellate Judge is a perverse finding and not in accordance with law. The very finding of the last court of fact is based on surmise and conjecture I also find that both the courts below concurrently found on discussion of the evidence on record that the plaintiffs are in possession of the suit land and thus the trial court rightly discarded the S.A. khatian Ext. Gha and Gha 1 and Ext. Kha and Ga series rent receipt. In view of the aforesaid state of facts the rule merits consideration. 

	15. Accordingly, the rule is made absolute without any order as to cost. The impugned judgment and decree dated 23.08.2000 and 02.09.2000 respectively passed by the learned Additional District Judge 3rd Court. Comilla in title appeal No. 265 of 1997 allowing the appeal in part and reversing the judgment and decree dated 09.07.1997 and 15.07.1997 passed by the learned Assistant Judge, is hereby set aside and the judgment and decree passed by the learned Assistant Judge, Burichong Comilla passed in title suit No. 111 of 1995 is hereby restored. There will be no order as to cost. 

	16. The order of stay operation of the impugned judgment and decree dated 23.08.2000 and 02.09.2000 respectively passed by the Learned Additional Districts Judge, 3rd Court, Comilla in Title Appeal No. 265 of 1997 is hereby re-called and vacated. 

	17. Send down the lower court record along with a copy of the judgment to the concern court forthwith for information and necessary action. 

	End.
